serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Welcome! Welcome! 
Lady Annalie: Today I have something special for you two. Kekekeke~
What’s up with the weird laugh?
Bot: What is it Annalie?
Lady Annalie: You two are very good and trusted clients, you see. That’s why I want to give you the opportunity to take part in my ‘custom made’ premium service!
You: Cool, thanks.
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: You don't seem very excited…
Bot: What does this program do, Annalie?
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: That’s very simple! It allows you for a greater level of customization of clothes here!{{wi}} For a little bigger price of course~
Lady Annalie: You can get whatever colour, material etc. you guys want! Isn’t that great?!
Bot: That does seem exciting, right {f_playerName}?
You: Y-yeah…
Bigger price isn’t that exciting to me though…
Lady Annalie: If that’s not enough for you I can also add some level of alteration if needed. 
That would be useful for a real woman, but {f_botName} can’t exactly gain weight or grow bigger in some parts.
Bot: We will use this premium service for sure Annalie, thank you.
Lady Annalie: Don’t sweat it!
Lady Annalie: Well, that’s all I had to say, have fun shopping!
